title: Project gets corrupted if compaction step is cancelled
body:
### Bug description

_No response_

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new project
2. Generate 5 hour chirp
3. Save and close the project
4. Open the project
5. Apply amplify
6. Save and discard changes
7. When Compaction dialog shows, click cancel
8. Wait till the project is closed
9. Open the project

### Expected behavior

The project should open at the original save state

### Actual behavior

The project does not open

### Audacity Version

Audacity 4.0.1 / Master

### Operating system

OS independent

_No response_
